binding_rule: Parent first admits exact template and input staging. Only actual held guard nonce,parent,keeper and once-only monotonic stage timestamps are bound in RAM by the frozen bootstrap; cutoff never moves. GO booleans/host-resolution review remain parent-owned.
bootstrap_code:
import ast,hashlib,json,pathlib,struct,sys,time,types
P=pathlib.Path
raw=P(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==sys.argv[2]
data=json.loads(raw);r=data['cache_release']
assert r['parent_released'] is True and r['cache_copy_go'] is True
for path,row in r['source_files'].items():
 b=P(path).read_bytes();assert len(b)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
def load(name):
 p=P(r['root'])/'execution/native-macos'/(name+'.py');b=p.read_bytes();row=r['source_files'][str(p)]
 assert len(b)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
 tree=ast.parse(b)
 for node in tree.body:
  names=[x.name for x in node.names] if isinstance(node,ast.Import) else [node.module] if isinstance(node,ast.ImportFrom) and node.module else []
  assert all(n.split('.')[0] in sys.stdlib_module_names for n in names)
 m=types.ModuleType(name);m.__file__=str(p);exec(compile(tree,str(p),'exec'),m.__dict__);m.__phase_source_sha256__=row['sha256'];return m
packet=P(data['runtime_input']['path']).read_bytes()
assert len(packet)==data['runtime_input']['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(packet).hexdigest()==data['runtime_input']['sha256']
n=struct.unpack('<I',packet[:4])[0];header=json.loads(packet[4:4+n]);payload=packet[4+n:];blobs={}
for f in header['members']:
 b=payload[f['offset']:f['offset']+f['bytes']]
 assert len(b)==f['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==f['sha256'];blobs[f['id']]=b
assert len(blobs)==8
token=json.loads((P(r['root'])/'mac-heavy.lock').read_bytes())
r.update(guard_nonce=token['nonce'],guard_parent=token['parent'],guard_keeper=token['keeper'])
now=time.monotonic();r.update(issued_monotonic=now,deadline_monotonic=min(now+r['stage_seconds'],now+r['fixed_cutoff']-time.time()))
rraw=json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode();sha=hashlib.sha256(rraw).hexdigest()
cases=load('native_cases_v36');cache=load('native_cache_activate_v36')
factory=cases.make_phase_runtime_factory(rraw,sha)
answer=cache.activate(rraw,sha,factory,blobs)
print(json.dumps({'template_sha256':sys.argv[2],'materialized_release_sha256':sha,'copy':answer},sort_keys=True))
